examples.arabic: بالمحل اختي اختارت جاكيت دافي وسالتني عن رايي
examples.english: In the shop my sister chose a warm jacket and asked me for my opinion.
examples.transliteration: bel mahal ekhti khtaret jacket dafi w saletni an rayei

examples.arabic: بدي اشتري جاكيت دافي قبل ما تبلش عاصفة كبيرة
examples.english: I want to buy a warm jacket before a big storm starts.
examples.transliteration: Baddi ishtiri jacket dafi qabel ma tballesh aasifa kbeereh

examples.arabic: رحت على السوق لادور على جاكيت دافي وحلو
examples.english: I went to the market to look for a nice warm jacket.
examples.transliteration: Ruht a'al souq la'addawwar a'ala jacket dafi w helu.

examples.english: Mom chose a warm jacket for me.
